budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.lead: Set what FOA plans to receive or spend in each category, month by month, in rupees. Leave the amount empty to clear a budget. A locked month can still get a budget: budgets plan, they don't post.
budgets.amountHint: For example 50,000. Leave it empty to clear the budget.
budgets.caption: Budgets by category and month, in rupees

report.title: Budget versus actual
report.lead: Actual is what the ledger shows for each category: income is money received less refunds, spending is money paid out. A late adjustment counts in the month it landed in.
report.categoriesCaption: Budget versus actual by category for the months shown
report.monthsCaption: Income, spending and the difference by month

export.title: Accountant export
export.lead: Download every ledger line between two dates as a CSV journal for FOA's accountant. Dates are days in India. Debits always equal credits, and the last row holds the totals. Downloading asks you to confirm it's you if you haven't recently, and goes in the audit log.
export.provisional: The columns are a first draft until FOA's accountant confirms them: journal number, date, period, account, debit, credit, narration, memo, source and whether a line is a late adjustment.

errors.forbidden: Only FOA finance staff can do this.
errors.invalid_input: Choose a category and a month, then try again.
errors.invalid_amount: Enter the budget in rupees, with up to two decimal places and no minus sign.
errors.not_budgetable: Budgets are for income and spending categories only.
errors.inactive_account: That category is inactive, so it takes no new budget.
errors.invalid_month: Enter both months as year and month, for example 2026-04.
errors.range_reversed: The start must be on or before the end.
errors.range_too_long: Choose a shorter range: up to two financial years for the report, up to 366 days for the export.
errors.export_not_enabled: The export is off until FOA's accountant confirms its format. A super admin can turn it on in Settings.
